C218476: An adverse event (AE) is any untoward medical occurrence in a clinical trial participant administered a medicinal product, which does not necessarily have a causal relationship with this treatment.
C218781: A serious adverse event (SAE) is any untoward medical occurrence that results in death, is life-threatening, requires inpatient hospitalisation or prolongation of existing hospitalisation, results in persistent or significant disability or incapacity, or is a congenital anomaly or birth defect.
C218782: A product complaint is any written, electronic, or oral communication that alleges deficiencies related to the identity, quality, durability, reliability, safety, effectiveness, or performance of a medicinal product.
C218783: A medical device product complaint is any written, electronic, or oral communication that alleges deficiencies related to the identity, quality, durability, reliability, safety, effectiveness, or performance of a medical device.

C218791: All adverse events will be collected from the time of informed consent until the end of the follow-up period as specified in the Schedule of Activities.
C218792: Adverse events will be identified through participant self-report, clinician observation, and review of clinical assessments at each visit.
C25676: The severity of adverse events will be graded according to the Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) version 5.0.
C82552: The causal relationship between each adverse event and the investigational product will be assessed by the investigator as either related or not related.
C218793: All adverse events will be recorded in the electronic case report form within 24 hours of the investigator becoming aware of the event.
C218794: All adverse events will be followed until resolution, stabilisation, or the event is otherwise explained.
C218795: Serious adverse events must be reported to the sponsor within 24 hours of the investigator becoming aware of the event.
C218796: The sponsor will report all suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions (SUSARs) to the relevant regulatory authorities in accordance with local requirements.
C217358: The following adverse events have been identified as adverse events of special interest (AESI) for this trial based on the known safety profile of the investigational product.
C218797: Disease-related events and outcomes that are expected in the study population and do not meet the criteria for adverse events will be recorded as protocol-specified disease assessments.
C218798: Female participants who become pregnant during the trial must be withdrawn from investigational product. Pregnancy outcomes will be followed up and reported.
C218799: If a male participant's partner becomes pregnant during the trial or within 90 days of the last dose, the participant must notify the investigator who will report the pregnancy to the sponsor.
C218800: Special safety situations include overdose, misuse, abuse, off-label use, medication errors, and occupational exposure. These must be reported to the sponsor within 24 hours.
